tools.name: bailaya_list_classes
tools.description: List the studio's classes (scheduled occurrences) with date, time, instructor, room, capacity and price. Needs scope classes:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/classes.

tools.name: bailaya_get_class
tools.description: Get one class by id. Needs scope classes:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/classes/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_list_events
tools.description: List the studio's events (workshops and special sessions) with date, time, instructor and capacity. Needs scope events:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: bailaya_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id. Needs scope events:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/events/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_list_students
tools.description: List the studio's students with name, email, phone, level and status. Personal data: use only when the studio owner asks. Needs scope students:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/students.

tools.name: bailaya_get_student
tools.description: Get one student by id. Personal data. Needs scope students:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/students/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_list_team_members
tools.description: List studio team members (staff, instructors, owners, admins), optionally filtered by role. Needs scope team:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/team.

tools.name: bailaya_get_team_member
tools.description: Get one team member by id. Needs scope team:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/team/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_list_instructors
tools.description: List the studio's instructors. Needs scope instructors:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/instructors.

tools.name: bailaya_get_instructor
tools.description: Get one instructor by id. Needs scope instructors:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/instructors/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_list_packages
tools.description: List class packages (pre-paid bundles of sessions) with price, sessions and validity. Set is_active to filter. Needs scope packages:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/packages.

tools.name: bailaya_get_package
tools.description: Get one class package by id. Needs scope packages:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/packages/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_list_rooms
tools.description: List the studio's rooms with capacity and location. Needs scope rooms:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/rooms.

tools.name: bailaya_get_room
tools.description: Get one room by id. Needs scope rooms:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/rooms/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_list_locations
tools.description: List the studio's locations (primary first). The API is not paginated: every location is returned. Needs scope locations:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/locations.

tools.name: bailaya_get_location
tools.description: Get one location by id. Needs scope locations:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/locations/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_list_dance_types
tools.description: List the studio's dance types (studio types) used to tag classes. Includes types hidden from the website. Needs scope classes:read. BailaYa API: GET /v1/studio-types.

tools.name: bailaya_create_class
tools.description: Create ONE class occurrence on a date. Visible on the studio's booking page. Needs scope classes:write. BailaYa API: POST /v1/classes.

tools.name: bailaya_update_class
tools.description: Change fields of one class (time, instructor, room, capacity, price). Only the fields you pass change. Needs scope classes:write. BailaYa API: PATCH /v1/classes/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_delete_class
tools.description: Delete (cancel) one class. Set apply_to_series to true to delete every occurrence of a repeating series. Irreversible. Needs scope classes:delete. BailaYa API: DELETE /v1/classes/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_create_event
tools.description: Create ONE event (workshop or special session) on a date. Visible on the studio's booking page. Needs scope events:write. BailaYa API: POST /v1/events.

tools.name: bailaya_update_event
tools.description: Change fields of one event (time, host, room, capacity, price). Only the fields you pass change. Needs scope events:write. BailaYa API: PATCH /v1/events/{id}.

tools.name: bailaya_create_student
tools.description: Add ONE student record to the studio. Personal data. Needs scope students:write. BailaYa API: POST /v1/students.

tools.name: bailaya_update_student
tools.description: Change fields of one student record (contact details, level, status). Only the fields you pass change. Personal data. Needs scope students:write. BailaYa API: PATCH /v1/students/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bailaya_list_students · Private data: bailaya_create_student, bailaya_update_student · Public sink: bailaya_list_students, bailaya_create_class, bailaya_create_event, bailaya_create_student · Destructive: bailaya_delete_class.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bailaya_list_students · Private data: bailaya_create_student, bailaya_update_student · Public sink: bailaya_list_students, bailaya_create_class, bailaya_create_event, bailaya_create_student · Destructive: bailaya_delete_class

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
